items.caption: This seal-script-style form of 本 has a tree-like upper structure and a horizontal mark across its lower part. In the traditional analysis, 木 represents a tree and 一 marks its base, indicating the root. This is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image.
items.alt: Bold black seal-script-style graph on white: a tree-like form with a horizontal stroke crossing its lower trunk.
items.selection_reason: It visibly illustrates the lower mark central to the traditional explanation of 本 as a root indicator, while its modern redraw status is made clear.

limitations.text: The image is a modern redraw of a seal-script-style form, not an ancient artifact. The early inscriptional history of 本 remains unsettled: a bronze example is listed by one source but not displayed by another, and an oracle-bone identification is disputed.
